title: PMCA1 loss selectively induces a thalamic calcium-activity and neurosecretory program
exact_observed_result: Atp2b1 knockdown in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut depleted Atp2b1 and induced immediate-early/neurosecretory genes including Chml, Fos, Cck, Vgf, Ptprn, and Nr4a1, while matched Atp2b2, Atp2b3, and Atp2c1 calcium-pump perturbations did not reproduce the module.
biological_interpretation: PMCA1 loss couples plasma-membrane calcium extrusion to an activity-like thalamic RNA state that is separable from PMCA2/PMCA3 buffering and SERCA2 ER stress.

evidence_records.statistics: 146 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; Atp2b1 logFC -0.852, Wilcoxon score -11.847, p=2.23e-32, FDR=3.84e-28; Atp2b1 was rank 1 by FDR and by absolute score in this stratum.
evidence_records.description: Strong on-target Atp2b1 depletion in the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class.

evidence_records.statistics: 21 non-target genes at FDR<0.05; 19 increased and 2 decreased. Examples: Chml logFC 0.674 FDR 5.67e-5; Fos logFC 1.026 FDR 9.33e-4; Cck logFC 0.326 FDR 2.48e-3; Vgf logFC 0.571 FDR 2.48e-3; Nr4a1 logFC 0.646 FDR 3.56e-3; Necab2 logFC -0.548 FDR 6.69e-3; Nr3c1 logFC -0.355 FDR 4.49e-2.
evidence_records.description: The full FDR 0.05 non-target program following Atp2b1 knockdown in the most responsive cell type.

evidence_records.statistics: Atp2b2: 280 perturbed cells, target logFC -1.019 FDR 8.94e-35, one FDR<0.05 gene total, Pearson r to Atp2b1 scores 0.085. Atp2b3: 188 perturbed cells, target logFC -0.649 FDR 5.31e-6, one FDR<0.05 gene total, Pearson r to Atp2b1 scores 0.0002.
evidence_records.description: Efficient knockdown of neuronal PMCA paralogs in the Atp2b1-responsive class did not reproduce the Atp2b1 downstream signature.

evidence_records.statistics: For Atp2a2 perturbation, 98 perturbed cells yielded 187 FDR<0.05 rows: Atp2a2 logFC -1.256 FDR=1.78e-19, Cars logFC 0.916 FDR=1.12e-9, Ddit3 logFC 1.604 FDR=2.06e-8, Shmt2 logFC 2.021 FDR=3.99e-8, Chac1 logFC 3.014 FDR=6.61e-8, Xbp1 logFC 0.785 FDR=3.00e-7, Herpud1 logFC 0.857 FDR=8.22e-7, Hspa5 logFC 0.749 FDR=1.95e-6, and Asns logFC 0.866 FDR=3.08e-6. In matched Atp2c1 perturbation, all listed UPR markers had FDR=1.0.
evidence_records.description: SERCA2/Atp2a2 depletion, unlike Atp2c1 depletion, induced a broad ER-stress signature in the thalamic glutamatergic class.

evidence_records.statistics: For Atp2a2 perturbation, 55 perturbed cells yielded 10 FDR<0.05 rows, including Atp2a2 logFC -1.228 FDR=9.54e-10, Chac1 logFC 2.344 FDR=0.0402, and Ddit3 logFC 1.631 FDR=0.0458; for Atp2c1 perturbation in the same cell type, Atp2c1 logFC -0.716 FDR=2.14e-4 while Xbp1 P=0.0336 FDR=1.0, Hspa5 P=0.337 FDR=1.0, Herpud1 P=0.169 FDR=1.0, Ddit3 P=0.794 FDR=1.0, and Chac1 P=0.986 FDR=1.0.
evidence_records.description: Midbrain glutamatergic cells showed a smaller but still significant Atp2a2 stress response that was absent after Atp2c1 perturbation.

caveats: Target engagement was inferred from transcript abundance, Bdnf remained nominal rather than FDR-significant, and calcium flux or PMCA protein were not measured.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior literature and pathway context were taken from the resolved report references; the observed Perturb-seq signal either refines expected gene function by cell type or marks an exploratory response-state neighbor where noted in caveats.

citations.citation: UniProtKB reviewed entries P20020 for ATP2B1_HUMAN and P16615 for AT2A2_HUMAN.
citations.supports: Defines ATP2B1/PMCA1 and ATP2A2/SERCA2 as curated calcium-transporting ATPases used to interpret the calcium-pump perturbations.

citations.citation: QuickGO term GO:0005388, P-type calcium transporter activity, and ATP2B1 annotations to this activity.
citations.supports: Provides the formal activity definition for ATP-driven Ca2+ transport out of the cytosol and supports the calcium-extrusion interpretation of ATP2B1.

citations.citation: Mata AM, Sepulveda MR. Plasma membrane Ca2+-ATPases in the nervous system during development and ageing. World J Biol Chem. 2010;1(7):229-234.
citations.supports: Review describing PMCAs as high-affinity Ca2+ regulators that are broadly expressed in brain and have nervous-system isoform specificity.

citations.citation: West AE, Chen WG, Dalva MB, Dolmetsch RE, Kornhauser JM, Shaywitz AJ, Takasu MA, Tao X, Greenberg ME. Calcium regulation of neuronal gene expression. Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A. 2001;98(20):11024-11031.
citations.supports: Summarizes how neuronal Ca2+ signals activate transcriptional programs, including CREB-linked BDNF regulation.

citations.citation: STRING database mouse functional-association API queried for Atp2b1, PMCA paralogs, calmodulins, and calcium-signaling neighbors.
citations.supports: Supplies functional-association support linking mouse PMCA family members and calmodulin/calcineurin calcium-signaling proteins.

citations.supports: Curated ATP2C1 function: Golgi Ca2+/Mn2+ pump, trans-Golgi localization, catalytic activity, and Hailey-Hailey disease annotation.

citations.citation: Reactome R-HSA-936837, Ion transport by P-type ATPases; R-HSA-936883, ATP2C1/2:Mg2+ transport cytosolic Ca2+ to Golgi lumen.
citations.supports: Places ATP2C1/SPCA1 in the curated P-type ATPase ion-transport pathway and Golgi Ca2+ transport reaction.

citations.supports: Curated ATP2A2 function as an ER/SR Ca2+ pump and disease annotation for Darier disease.

citations.citation: Reactome R-HSA-381119, Unfolded Protein Response; R-HSA-380994, ATF4 activates genes in response to endoplasmic reticulum stress; R-HSA-381038, XBP1(S) activates chaperone genes.
citations.supports: Curated ER-stress and UPR pathway context for the Atp2a2-induced markers.
